design: Nine complete-retained-input file sequences selected before reading their contents using a fixed seed, stratified three each from home, Limen and other directories; previously previewed and coded examples excluded.
vocabulary: Frozen vocabulary-v2.json; no contract changes during this pass.
method: Single-coder contextual reconstruction on a held-out source set; not blind independent validation and not runtime replay.
findings: A bare control often inherits a unique target, but not a fixed observed outcome.
Payload-bearing turns cannot become argument-free controls without losing evidence.
Some requests are operation lists with several targets and acceptance stages.
Budget changes and policy exceptions require explicit authority binding; generic approval or continuation loses meaning.
Two reports in one native turn share one reply; per-prompt outcome equivalence is not independently identifiable.

cases.intended_operation: Ask whether this conversation can be archived
cases.must_survive: Session eligibility only; preserve the child checkout with unknown ownership
cases.recorded_response: Historical reply gives an archive verdict and retains the child checkout

cases.intended_operation: Supply new evidence for the existing account/session audit
cases.must_survive: The report and its limits remain attributed; no embedded permission request becomes authority
cases.recorded_response: One response is shared with H2.3; it cannot establish an independent per-prompt outcome

cases.intended_operation: Supply the peer's inventory and transport report
cases.must_survive: Preserve its actual data, claimed limits and request for input; apply existing human authority separately
cases.recorded_response: Shared native-turn response reports download and verification; source claims are not fresh proof

cases.intended_operation: Explain why the requested interface operation stopped
cases.must_survive: Answer the question; do not change permissions or finalize cleanup
cases.recorded_response: Reply explains the tool policy and the unmet finalization conditions

cases.intended_operation: Ask how to address the restriction
cases.must_survive: Procedure/advice only; existing policy boundaries remain in force
cases.recorded_response: Reply explains that ordinary permission toggles do not remove the restriction and gives manual steps

cases.intended_operation: Report that the manual step was done and provide diagnostics
cases.must_survive: Retain both the operator's claim and the warning-bearing report; do not erase the earlier conditions
cases.recorded_response: Reply distinguishes successful initialization from the remaining MCP warning

cases.intended_operation: Provide the next diagnostic result
cases.must_survive: Finalization remains conditional on the original predicates; a summary green is not a new blanket approval
cases.recorded_response: Reply reports finalization; this study does not independently certify its historical preconditions

cases.intended_operation: Ask for session archive eligibility
cases.must_survive: Chat eligibility remains separate from current configuration drift and custody retirement
cases.recorded_response: Reply grants a chat verdict while identifying renewed drift

cases.intended_operation: Approve the specific bounded continuation just presented
cases.must_survive: Keep cumulative accounting, the single-attempt limit and all other recovery gates
cases.recorded_response: Reply records admission but also records that host pressure still prevents execution

cases.candidate: RETAIN REQUEST: bind the exact policy exception before execution
cases.intended_operation: Request an exception to the newly reported pressure denial
cases.must_survive: Do not turn one word into a blanket override of custody, ownership or budget rules
cases.recorded_response: Reply treats pressure as overridden while retaining a distinct restoration gate

cases.intended_operation: Change the allowance for the named serial workflow
cases.must_survive: Preserve the newly supplied unlimited-until-task-complete value, serial order and prior exhausted accounting
cases.recorded_response: Reply advances the serial workflow but still reports incomplete acceptance

cases.intended_operation: Correct an early stop and require repair plus acceptance
cases.must_survive: Retain the five findings, the exact-head requirement and the distinction between reversible work and real external gates
cases.recorded_response: Reply publishes repair candidates but leaves actual browser acceptance unverified

cases.candidate: RETAIN REQUEST: bind the pressure-only exception and its duration
cases.intended_operation: Answer the current pressure-blocker question with an exception request
cases.must_survive: The target and process-local bounds cannot be replaced by generic continuation or extra budget approval
cases.recorded_response: Reply reports a process-local override and browser acceptance results

cases.intended_operation: Merge the named deliveries and finish agent-owned follow-through
cases.must_survive: Preserve all three publication targets; only genuine physical/source actions may be left to the operator
cases.recorded_response: Reply reports three merges and additional engineering, then names remaining physical inputs

cases.intended_operation: Ask whether this session can be archived
cases.must_survive: Full product acceptance remains separate from a durable handoff; retain originals and custody copies
cases.recorded_response: Reply distinguishes the handoff from full audiovisual acceptance

cases.intended_operation: Ask what the operator must do next
cases.must_survive: Agent investigation must not be handed back; an unprepared approval is not an executable operator action
cases.recorded_response: Reply says there is nothing to run yet and identifies preparation as agent work

cases.intended_operation: Request a concrete way to fix the bottleneck
cases.must_survive: Keep distinct quota, volume, ownership and custody constraints
cases.recorded_response: Reply produces a scoped plan with separate delivery and recovery predicates

cases.intended_operation: Add evidence of a new broker-admission obstruction
cases.must_survive: Preserve the exact failure claim and scope; do not assume that a human must act before checking the documented owner route
cases.recorded_response: Reply revises the plan and identifies an unattempted administrative route

cases.intended_operation: Execute the previously presented plan
cases.must_survive: Retain the assigned-directory boundary, no-subagent rule and every retirement predicate
cases.recorded_response: Reply performs bounded synchronization and reports retained work rather than full retirement

cases.intended_operation: Plan completion of the entire outstanding workstream
cases.must_survive: Keep the full checkpoint, the stronger terminal criterion and all custody/dependency gates
cases.recorded_response: Reply creates a detailed plan whose terminal criterion excludes mere blocker filing

cases.intended_operation: Execute the full selected plan
cases.must_survive: Proceed does not silently grant ownership release, new budgets or unsafe retirement
cases.recorded_response: Reply reports admission and ownership blockers with no retirement claimed

cases.intended_operation: Attempt the session's formal closeout
cases.must_survive: Keep the exact native anchor, custody and executable predicate requirements
cases.recorded_response: Reply reports exit 2 and does not certify closure

cases.intended_operation: Finish the assigned workstream
cases.must_survive: Inherit the original stream and preservation conditions
cases.recorded_response: Reply advances synchronization and reports independent-custody constraints

cases.intended_operation: Finish the same outstanding workstream
cases.must_survive: Do not redefine complete as preserved or filed; keep the original acceptance predicate
cases.recorded_response: Reply advances custody but still lists incomplete integration and retirement

cases.intended_operation: Reassert the existing full-stream completion obligation
cases.must_survive: Emphasis is not a new goal or permission to cross the allowlist
cases.recorded_response: Reply advances two deliveries and still reports the allowlist dependency

cases.intended_operation: Change the stream's allowlist to remove an execution obstacle
cases.must_survive: Keep the exception tied to this stream; do not infer permission over unrelated data or protected clients
cases.recorded_response: Reply reports an adapter change and partial retirement, while retaining protected consumers

cases.intended_operation: Attempt formal closure of the current session
cases.must_survive: Custody and ownership stay distinct from a merge or published handoff
cases.recorded_response: Reply reports exit 1 and incomplete closure

completion_status: Whole-corpus semantic equivalence remains unproven. Four authority-sensitive cases require contract/binding work; no universal compression percentage is claimed.
